title: Problems with MRT Trains Delivered in 2013
what_it_is: Problems with MRT Trains Delivered in 2013

sections.label: Train defects rectified before tenders
sections.summary: Defects were rectified at the supplier's cost to LTA's satisfaction before 2014 and 2015 train tenders, which were open and objective.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Transport (Mr Khaw Boon Wan)
sentences.text: After the defects were discovered, they immediately committed to making the rectifications to the Land Transport Authority's full satisfaction.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Transport (Mr Khaw Boon Wan)
sentences.text: All costs, including shipping, are borne by them.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Transport (Mr Khaw Boon Wan)
sentences.text: The concern about the defects had thus been resolved when we called the tender for more trains in 2014 and 2015.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Transport (Mr Khaw Boon Wan)
sentences.text: Our train tenders have always been conducted in an open and transparent manner, and are based objectively on quality and price assessments.

sections.label: Bolsters from Japan
sections.summary: The subsequent contracts will have the bolsters from Japan.

sentences.speaker: Mr Khaw Boon Wan
sentences.text: The subsequent contracts will have the bolsters from Japan.
